notes.title: Chi Busters
notes.content: Prepare to join the battle of a game studio. Chi Busters puts the player in the shoes of different game makers. Use each of these different characters and learn their unique powers. Be a developer, a writer, a producer, and more! All 24 characters come with unique skills in this chibi fighting game.

notes.title: Chi Busters
notes.content: Join the battle of a game studio in the upcoming fighting game Chi Busters. With 24 characters to choose from, discover all of their unique powers. Take these fighters and battle across six stages becoming the ultimate chibi fighter.

notes.title: This Holiday Season !!
notes.content: Enter a game that combines two trends in a new way. Chi Busters takes the chibi art style of Japan and combines it with the fighting game genre. This combination creates a unique fighting style and animation. Feel free to grab this fighting game for $1.99 soon!

notes.title: Black Banshee Studio's Chi Busters !!
notes.content: Check out one of the latest games of Black Banshee Games! Chi Busters! This is a fighting game that allows you to partake in a silly setting. It will be a great game to have at social gatherings in order to beat your friends up in fun and silly ways. Pick up the game later in December for $1.99!

notes.title: This Christmas !!
notes.content: This holiday season gift your friends and family with this fun fighting game. Chi Busters is a new and exciting fighting game. The best part about it though is it’s $1.99. Share the joy of a new game and beat up your competitors.

notes.title: Coming soon !
notes.content: Chi Busters is a new fighting game that will bring players into a chibified world. Take each of these cute fighters into battle, and you’ll be able to fully explore your new chibi powers.
